test_healthcheck_endpoints: test that the /healthcheck and /admin/healthcheck endpoints return 200 with ok in the response
test_hidden_endpoints: test that the /, /metrics, and /admin/metrics endpoints return 404 Not Found
run_healthcheck_tests: run the parametrized pytest tests to verify healthcheck endpoints are accessible and return ok
run_hidden_endpoint_tests: run the parametrized pytest tests to verify root and metrics endpoints are hidden and return 404
review_healthcheck_test_coverage: review the test file to ensure healthcheck and hidden endpoint tests cover all expected endpoints
